VERSION 3.28.0.164

; PaperHid controls in Settings > Help. Independent of MainView / cursor FIFO.
; Every command and argument is fixed at parse time (paperhid-ui allow-list).
AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Help.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0

    TRAVERSE Background#root > ScrollArea#flickable > Item#itemWrapper > ColumnLayout#column
        LOCATE BEFORE ArkControls.Body#supportText
        INSERT {
            ColumnLayout {
                id: paperPointerSettingsRoot
                objectName: "paperpointer-settings-root"
                spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium
                Layout.fillWidth: true

                property string actionStatus: qsTr("Ready")
                property string statusBuf: ""
                property string pairedSummary: qsTr("Paired devices: (refresh)")
                property string layoutSummary: qsTr("Layout: (refresh)")
                property string pointerSummary: qsTr("Pointer: (refresh)")
                property bool pointerInstalled: false
                property bool mutationBusy: false

                function setBusy(v) {
                    mutationBusy = v;
                }

                function applyStatusJson(text) {
                    var raw = (text || "").trim();
                    if (!raw.length)
                        return;
                    try {
                        var j = JSON.parse(raw);
                        if (!j || j.ok === false) {
                            actionStatus = (j && j.error) ? j.error : qsTr("Status error");
                            return;
                        }
                        var ad = j.adapter || {};
                        var sv = j.services || {};
                        var kb = j.keyboard || {};
                        var lines = [];
                        lines.push(qsTr("BT adapter: %1 powered=%2")
                            .arg(ad.present ? qsTr("yes") : qsTr("no"))
                            .arg(ad.powered ? qsTr("yes") : qsTr("no")));
                        lines.push(qsTr("Services: bt=%1 kb=%2 ptr=%3")
                            .arg(sv.bluetooth || "?")
                            .arg(sv.keyboard || "?")
                            .arg(sv.pointer || "?"));
                        if (kb.saved_mac)
                            lines.push(qsTr("Saved keyboard: %1").arg(kb.saved_mac));
                        else
                            lines.push(qsTr("Saved keyboard: (none)"));
                        if (kb.layout)
                            layoutSummary = qsTr("Layout: %1").arg(kb.layout);
                        else
                            layoutSummary = qsTr("Layout: (stock / unknown)");
                        if (j.last_error)
                            lines.push(qsTr("Last error: %1").arg(j.last_error));
                        actionStatus = lines.join("\n");

                        var paired = j.paired || [];
                        if (!paired.length) {
                            pairedSummary = qsTr("Paired devices: (none)");
                        } else {
                            var pl = [];
                            for (var i = 0; i < paired.length; i++) {
                                var d = paired[i];
                                pl.push((d.name || "?") + "  " + (d.mac || "")
                                    + (d.connected ? qsTr(" [connected]") : "")
                                    + (d.trusted ? qsTr(" [trusted]") : ""));
                            }
                            pairedSummary = qsTr("Paired devices:\n") + pl.join("\n");
                        }

                        var ptr = j.pointer || {};
                        pointerInstalled = !!ptr.installed;
                        if (!ptr.installed) {
                            pointerSummary = qsTr("Pointer: not installed (keyboard-only OK)");
                        } else {
                            pointerSummary = qsTr("Pointer: svc=%1 cursor=%2 hide_ms=%3 accel=%4 style=%5")
                                .arg(ptr.service || "?")
                                .arg(String(ptr.cursor))
                                .arg(String(ptr.cursor_hide_ms))
                                .arg(String(ptr.accel))
                                .arg(ptr.cursor_style || "?");
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        actionStatus = qsTr("Bad status JSON");
                    }
                }

                function refreshStatus() {
                    statusBuf = "";
                    paperHidStatusCommand.startCommand(100);
                }

                function onMutationFinished(okText) {
                    setBusy(false);
                    if (okText && okText.length)
                        actionStatus = okText.trim();
                    refreshStatus();
                }

                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    font.bold: true
                    text: qsTr("PaperHid")
                }

                // --- Status ---
                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: qsTr("Status")
                }

                ArkControls.Body {
                    id: paperPointerStatusText
                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                ArkControls.Button {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                    text: qsTr("Refresh status")

                }

                // --- Bluetooth ---
                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: qsTr("Bluetooth")
                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                    ArkControls.Button {

                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("BT on")
                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.mutationBusy
                        onClicked: {
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.setBusy(true);
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = qsTr("Bluetooth on...");
                            paperHidBtOn.outBuf = "";
                            paperHidBtOn.startCommand(100);

                XoviMessageBroker {
                    listeningFor: ["paperpointer.settings.ping"]

                    function onSignalReceived(signal, message) {
                        if (signal === "paperpointer.settings.ping")
                            return "paperpointer-settings-qml-3.28.0.164";
                        return "";
                    }
                }

                // --- Executors: fixed command + fixed args; accumulate stdout ---

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperHidStatusCommand
                    command: "/home/root/.paperhid/paperhid-ui"
                    arguments: ["status"]

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.statusBuf += output;
                    }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (!running && paperPointerSettingsRoot.statusBuf.length) {
                            var buf = paperPointerSettingsRoot.statusBuf;
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.statusBuf = "";
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.applyStatusJson(buf);
                        }
                    }
                    Component.onCompleted: paperPointerSettingsRoot.refreshStatus()
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperHidBtOn
                    command: "/home/root/.paperhid/paperhid-ui"
                    arguments: ["bluetooth-on"]
                    property string outBuf: ""
                    property bool launched: false
                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) { outBuf += output; }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running) launched = true;
                        else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.onMutationFinished(outBuf);
                            outBuf = "";
                        }
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperHidBtOff
                    command: "/home/root/.paperhid/paperhid-ui"

    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
